panels.h3: 20 x 8 ft Container Marketing Office: 160 sq ft Front Desk
panels.paragraph: This is the smallest approved plan and the cheapest way to put a staffed face on a plot. One external door sits in the middle of the front wall, with a window on each side of it. Three workstations run along the rear wall, and both end walls stay clear. There is no toilet and no pantry here, so the site must already supply both. Pick it for a single plot, a highway display board or a short launch weekend.
applications: 160 sq ft, 1 external door, 6 windows, 3 workstations, no partitions
Rs 3,34,400 ex-GST and Rs 3,94,592 with 18 per cent GST
Deep Oxford Blue exterior with a Warm Ivory interior
Ceiling-flush storage above every desk keeps the 8 ft width walkable

panels.h3: 20 x 16 ft Marketing Office with Pantry and Two Toilets
panels.paragraph: Doubling the width buys the first self-sufficient plan. A five-foot wet strip runs down one end and holds a ladies toilet, a gents toilet and a shared wash area with one basin. A pantry sits beside it. The rest is one room with four workstations and a six-seat discussion table, so a sales talk and a desk shift can run at once. The service end carries no window and no door, only two high-level exhaust louvres.
applications: 320 sq ft, 1 external door, 4 internal doors, 5 windows, 4 workstations
Rs 5,77,600 ex-GST and Rs 6,81,568 with 18 per cent GST
Toilets 5 x 5 ft each, shared wash 5 x 6 ft, pantry 5 x 6 ft
Graphite Charcoal exterior with a Porcelain Sage interior

panels.h3: 40 x 8 ft Marketing Office: Manager Cabin and Seven Desks
panels.paragraph: Same 8 ft width as the smallest plan, twice the length. A 10 ft manager cabin takes the left end behind one partition, and a 30 ft common office fills the rest. Seven workstations sit in a single run along the rear wall, which keeps the aisle clear from door to door. Two external doors let staff and visitors enter without crossing. There is no toilet and no pantry on this plate, so plan both of those separately.
applications: 320 sq ft, 2 external doors, 1 internal door, 9 windows, 7 workstations
Rs 5,77,600 ex-GST and Rs 6,81,568 with 18 per cent GST
Manager cabin 10 x 8 ft with the manager seat and two guest seats
Eucalyptus Grey-Green exterior with a Mist Blue-Grey interior

panels.h3: 40 x 16 ft Marketing Office with Conference and Manager
panels.paragraph: Here the plan splits into three parts. A 10 ft cabin zone at one end holds a manager room and a six-seat conference room, both 10 x 8 ft. A 25 ft common office follows, with seven workstations and a clear central aisle. A five-foot service strip closes the far end with two toilets, a shared wash and a pantry. Both external doors open into the common office, so no visitor walks through a private room.
applications: 640 sq ft, 2 external doors, 6 internal doors, 9 windows, 7 workstations
Rs 11,18,720 ex-GST and Rs 13,20,090 with 18 per cent GST
Two workstations on the front wall and five on the rear wall

panels.h3: 40 x 24 ft Marketing Office: Reception, Island, Service
panels.paragraph: This is the first plan with a real front-of-house. A reception and waiting bay of 10 x 8 ft holds the counter, one operator and four waiting seats. A manager cabin and a conference room sit behind it. The open office then carries fourteen workstations, six of them on a centre island arranged three facing three. A print store and a server room join the toilets and the pantry in the five-foot service strip at the far end.
applications: 960 sq ft, 2 external doors, 9 internal doors, 10 windows, 14 workstations
Rs 16,41,600 ex-GST and Rs 19,37,088 with 18 per cent GST

panels.h3: 40 x 32 ft Marketing Office: Four Rooms, Two Islands
panels.paragraph: The largest approved plate turns the module into a sales gallery. Four rooms of 10 x 8 ft line the front. They are reception and waiting, a manager cabin, a small conference room and a sales or HR cabin. The open office behind them holds twenty workstations, twelve of them on two islands of three facing three. Print, server, archive and utility rooms sit beside the toilets, so the support load never spills into the sales floor.
applications: 1,280 sq ft, 2 external doors, 12 internal doors, 11 windows, 20 workstations
